report_list: Update Patient Insurance (Conversion) List - By Appointment
Responsible Party - Email Statement Error Report
observations: Third-reader verified inventory. All 13 original screenshots, all 26 pre-rendered zooms and additional tight crops were read. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, control, option list, default value and enabled state (84 controls each; they differed only in report order and note wording); every point was nevertheless re-checked on the pixels. One typing change was made by the third reader: the Patient box + SEARCH button of Patient's Notes is recorded as text_input + button instead of one picker (see TYPING CONVENTION), which gives 85 controls. An automated pixel scan of every criteria panel (every pixel that is not one of the panel's flat fill colours, clustered into boxes) found nothing beyond the controls listed here: no tiny right-edge checkbox (no 'Page Break'), no extra column, no instruction / warning / legend text, no scrollbar, no footer text. COVERAGE: 13 screenshots = 12 reports, every report of the list is shown selected at least once (blue radio dot): 1.PNG and 9.PNG = Update Patient Insurance (Conversion) List - By Appointment (pixel-identical apart from a 6 px vertical shift - a duplicate capture); 2 = Patient List; 3 = Patient List - New Patient; 4 = Patients Seen; 5 = Patient's Notes; 6 = Patient List - Grouped By; 7 = Patients on Payment Plan; 8 = Online Registered Patients; 10 = Responsible Party List; 11 = Responsible Party - Sent to Collection; 12 = Responsible Party - Statements Sent; 13 = Responsible Party - Email Statement Error Report. All 13 are the normal two-panel screen: no popup, no expanded dropdown, no scrolled second view, no foreign screen. TITLE BAR (identical in all 13): 'Patient/Resp. Party List Reports' at the left; 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon (icon only, no text) at the far right. LEFT PANEL: this category has NO 'SELECT REPORT' header. The panel holds two groups, each with its own blue header bar and its own two-column grid of radio cells: 'PATIENT LIST' (8 reports, 4 rows x 2 columns) and 'RESPONSIBLE PARTY LIST' (4 reports, 2 rows x 2 columns). report_list is given group by group - PATIENT LIST left column top-to-bottom, then its right column, then RESPONSIBLE PARTY LIST left column, then its right column - so the first 8 names belong to PATIENT LIST and the last 4 to RESPONSIBLE PARTY LIST. Two names wrap onto a second line inside their cell ('Update Patient Insurance (Conversion)' / 'List - By Appointment' and 'Responsible Party - Email Statement' / 'Error Report'). Each group ends with a thin divider line carrying a small blue '...' handle tab, and a vertical three-dot grip sits in a notch on the border between the left and right panels (collapse / resize handles). Below the second group the panel is uniform empty navy down to the window edge, so the list is NOT scrollable or clipped. RIGHT PANEL 'REPORT CRITERIA': the grey-styled CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) sits at the right end of the blue header bar - it is grey in all 13 screenshots, which is its normal styling (the other category inventories record the same), not a disabled state; the action bar at the bottom of the panel holds the blue PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon) buttons, right-aligned. All three actions appear for every report. NO TRUNCATION: in every screenshot the first section header is fully visible under the panel border, the last criteria row is followed by blank panel space down to the action bar, and no scrollbar is drawn on either panel. RECURRING PATTERNS: (1) PRINT FORMAT = PDF (selected) / Excel on every report - either the full-width first section, or the right column of the first row beside REPORT BY, PLAN TYPE or STATEMENT TYPE. (2) OFFICE/GROUP = radios Office (selected) / Office Group, both ENABLED, then an unlabelled read-only box '108' (the OID of the title bar) with a blue, enabled SELECT button - on every report except Patient's Notes (in ledger_reports.json the same Office Group radio and SELECT button are greyed out; here they are not). In two-column layouts the OFFICE/GROUP header and radios occupy the left column beside PROVIDER / PREFERRED PROVIDER and the office box + SELECT row follows beneath, across the panel. (3) Every date box shows 11/21/2026 = the capture day (MM/DD/YYYY, calendar icon inside the box), i.e. dates appear to default to today. (4) Unlabelled controls: many sections have no row label, the grey section header being the only caption (all radio rows, the office box, INCLUDE / EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE, EXCLUDE RESPONSIBLE PARTY TYPE, PRINT NOTES, and the REPORT BY, SEX, SPECIALTY and CREDIT CARD ON FILE dropdowns); labelled rows are Provider, Preferred Provider, Patient, Start Date / End Date, Statement Date, Statement Sent Date, From / To and Start / End. (5) SELECT button icons: building for the office box and for PRINT NOTES; single person for Provider / Preferred Provider; person-plus for INCLUDE / EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE and EXCLUDE RESPONSIBLE PARTY TYPE; the SEARCH button has a magnifier. TYPING CONVENTION: read-only picker boxes are drawn with a grey fill (RGB 220,223,226); editable inputs (date boxes, dropdowns, Age From / To, balance Start / End and the Patient box of Patient's Notes) with a lighter fill (RGB 241,241,241). Grey box + SELECT is recorded as ONE picker with the button described in its notes; the light Patient box + SEARCH is recorded as text_input plus a separate SEARCH button, the same convention as in daily_reports.json, ledger_reports.json and management_reports.json. DISABLED CONTROLS: the only greyed-out items in the category are the 'Email' and 'Both' options of STATEMENT TYPE in Responsible Party - Statements Sent (12.PNG); the radio group is recorded enabled = true with the partial disabling described in its notes. Every SELECT / SEARCH button and every other radio, checkbox, dropdown and input is drawn in its normal enabled style (button fills sampled: all blue). NOT CAPTURED (needs follow-up screenshots): every dropdown is collapsed, so only the current value is known - REPORT BY ('Appointment' in Patient List - New Patient, 'Day' in Patients Seen, 'Attached to Provider' in Patient List - Grouped By, 'Created Date' in Responsible Party List), SEX ('------'), SPECIALTY ('ALL') and CREDIT CARD ON FILE ('Both'). No dialog is shown, so the contents behind the office, office-group, provider, patient-type, responsible-party-type and PRINT NOTES SELECT buttons and behind the patient SEARCH button are unknown. Whether changing REPORT BY (or REPORT TYPE / PLAN TYPE / Office Group) alters the sections below it cannot be told from these screenshots. ABSENT in this category: GROUP BY and SORT BY sections, listboxes, Page Break checkboxes, free-standing instruction text. Only two checkboxes exist: 'Include Patients With No Email' (Patient List, checked) and 'Include Inactive Accounts (All patients inactive in account)' (Responsible Party List, unchecked). RENDERING CAVEAT: in the bold section-header font the capital G shows almost no crossbar at this resolution, so the headers look like 'OFFICE/CROUP', 'ACE RANCE', 'DATE RANCE', 'APPOINTMENT DATE RANCE', 'CREATED DATE RANCE', 'PLAN SETUP DATE RANCE' and 'ACCOUNT BALANCE RANCE'; a native-resolution pixel dump shows a heavier lower-right terminal on those glyphs than on the true C of 'OFFICE', and they are transcribed OFFICE/GROUP, AGE RANGE, DATE RANGE and so on (same reading as in the other category inventories). Screenshot sizes: 1366x598, 1364x590, 1366x592, 1366x587, 1366x589, 1366x583, 1366x582, 1366x583, 1366x582, 1366x579, 1366x590, 1366x586 and 1365x581 px (for 1.PNG to 13.PNG); the thin grey strip at the very bottom of some screenshots is the window edge and carries no text. No reading needed a '[?]' marker.
